itens.trecho: O mais "adulto" e emotivo filme da franquia. Toy Story foi um gigantesco sucesso. Os dois primeiros filmes foram aclamados pela crítica especializada e um sucesso esmagador de bilheteira. Não foi, por isso, de ânimo leve que a Pixar fez um terceiro filme. Mas aqui os anos já passaram, o Andy cresceu, vai para fora de casa, para a faculdade.

Though "Andy" hasn't played with his toys in many a year, he still can't bear to be parted with them as he heads to college, so he puts them in a bin bag destined for the attic. Unfortunately, mom mistakes it for unwanted stuff and outside they go.

I don't love 'Toy Story 3' as much as its two predecessors. That doesn't mean that it isn't anything other than great though. I enjoy the bountiful humour and intriguing plot, while the newly-introduced toys are very good.
